benefits.text: Vegan Lip Glow tinted lip balm with a moist, smooth, soft and lightweight texture that brings bright, fresh pigment to the skin. Its formula contains 70% moisturizing ingredients, 3 plant oils from sunflower seed, Jojoba seed and almond, plus shea butter and an oil layer that helps lock in moisture to moisturize lips more deeply.

howToUse.text: Apply directly to lips, and you can layer multiple coats to reach the intensity you want.

safety.text:
For external use on the lip area only; do not use on damaged lips,
Stop use if any unusual signs appear and keep out of reach of children.

shadeDescription.text: Light pink with a dominant rose tone

positioning.text: A natural rose-pink tinted lip balm that creates a soft, lightly glossy, fresh and elegant lip effect.

sellingPoints.text: Vegan tinted lip balm; light-gliding, soft and thin texture; moisturizes like a lip balm while still giving fresh color.

texture.text: Tinted lip balm, soft, glides on lightly.

finish.text: Light glow / tinted balm / soft, moist lips.

claimDisclaimers.text: “Moisturizing” must not be interpreted as treating dry/cracked lips. “Non-sticky/comfortable all day” should be worded softly, not as an absolute promise under all conditions.

shadeDescription.text: Orange-brown with a hint of rose

positioning.text: A deep red-pink tinted lip balm that gives a more noticeable lip color than the nude shades while staying soft, glossy and easy to wear.

sellingPoints.text: Vegan tinted lip balm; soft, smooth balm that feels light on lips; color can be layered from natural to more defined.

texture.text: Tinted lip balm, soft, glides on lightly.

finish.text: Light glow / soft red-pink / moist lips.

claimDisclaimers.text: Do not say the color lasts like a lip tint. Color may need reapplying after eating or drinking or after long wear.
